Looking at this qlang documentation and the tasks, I'll work through each query carefully using only the patterns shown in the laws.

Let me trace through the key concepts:
- Steps combine with `|`, `*` applies to elements, `!|` handles failures
- `/field` reads fields, `at :field` reads softly (returns null if missing)
- `groupBy ~expr` groups by expression result
- `sort ~expr` sorts by expression value
- `distinct` removes duplicates (returns a set)

Here are my queries:

K1: `["Apple","banana","APPLE","Cherry","banana","date","Date","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | count`

K2: `/ | filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~/customer | * (* (at :total | coalesce 0) | sum)`

K3: `/ | lines | * (split " " | /1) | groupBy ~ | * count`

K4: `/ | (/dependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) | union (/devDependencies | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys) | sort`

K5: `/ | filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(0 | sub (at :comments | coalesce 0)), /id]) | * /id | take 3`

K6: `/ | lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(if (/2 | lower | eq "de") ~(/1 | count | gt 0) ~(false)) | :ages (* /1 | * (parseJson)) | [(:ages | sum), (:ages | count)] | /0 | div /1 | mul 10 | round | div 10`

K7: `/ | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | filter ~(type /port | eq ::number) | sort ~/port | vals`

K8: `/ | /results | filter ~(if (/email | ne null) ~(if (/user/name/last | ne null) ~(/email | split "@" | /1 | lower | eq "example.com") ~(false)) ~(false)) | * (/user/name/last | append ", " | append /user/name/first)`

K9: `/ | filter ~(if (/user | ne null) ~(/action | lower | eq "login") ~(false)) | * /user | * lower | distinct | sort`

K10: `/ | filter ~(if (at :salary | ne null) ~(true) ~(false)) | groupBy ~/dept | * (*(/ salary) | sum | div (*(/ salary) | count) | mul 100 | round | div 100)`

K11: `/ | * /tags | * (if (at :null | ne null) ~(if (count | gt 0) ~(split ",") ~([])) ~([])) | flat | * lower | filter ~(count | gt 0) | groupBy ~ | * count | sort | reverse | take 3`

K12: `/ | lines | filter ~(if (/0 | eq "#") ~(false) ~(if (count | gt 0) ~(true) ~(false))) | * (split "|" | /1 | parseJson | mul (/2 | parseJson)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100`

K13: `/ | /services | filter ~(/env | lower | eq "prod") | every ~(at :replicas | coalesce 1 | gte 2)`

K14: `/ | * {:id /id :itemCount (at :items | coalesce [] | * /qty | sum)} | filter ~(/itemCount | gt 0) | sort ~([0 | sub /itemCount, /id]) | take 3`
